description: This file defines a singly linked list data structure with methods for adding, removing, retrieving elements by index, and computing the list size. It includes an internal Node class and utility functions within a companion object.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation allowing addition, removal, and access to elements.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: An internal class representing a node in the linked list containing data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list, returning true if successful.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index, throwing IndexOutOfBoundsException if out of range.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private helper method to unlink a node from the list during removal.
